verdict.rationale: Missive's official MCP server lets external assistants like Claude or ChatGPT read and act on your conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts, and the changelog cites asking Claude to summarize your inbox. The built-in assistant runs on a bring-your-own Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini key, and its only documented Q&A use is answering from the Missive docs. So cross-inbox questioning depends on an external AI app or your own API key. Missing for 10: evidence that the native assistant answers questions across the whole inbox and calendar, grounding or citation of answers back to specific messages, examples of 'who said what / what's outstanding' queries, and independent hands-on corroboration.
